# Security policy

Security fixes target the latest release on the 2.x line.

Report vulnerabilities through [GitHub's private reporting form](https://github.com/alman790/Veyra-IDE/security/advisories/new). Include the affected version, operating system, relevant SDK/server versions, and a minimal reproduction. Keep exploit details out of public issues while a report is being assessed.

Veyra launches compilers, language servers, debugger adapters, and project-defined build commands with the current user's permissions. SDK and build configurations are part of the report when the issue involves process execution.
